name: supermodel-sunset-beach
image_vibe: 90s supermodel glamour, golden backlight, dreamy ocean halation
image_purpose: Create a vertical beach fashion portrait with cinematic sunset light.

prompt.project_info: A 9:16 photorealistic waist-up fashion portrait on a golden-hour beach.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with voluminous layered brunette hair in a 90s supermodel blowout style, confident glamorous gaze, glowing natural tan skin, and a black strapless tube top with secure coverage. She wears layered gold necklaces including a prominent cross pendant and small hoop earrings.
prompt.composition_elements: Waist-up forward-facing pose with a slight head tilt and hair flowing over the shoulders. Place shimmering ocean water, sun-reflected waves, and a softly blurred horizon behind her.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Setting-sun backlight, warm golden glow, sun flares, halation, sparkling water highlights, soft diffusion, and ethereal vintage-glam warmth.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 vertical portrait, 85mm lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, photorealistic natural skin texture, controlled filmic color, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic 9:16 waist-up portrait of an original adult woman with long voluminous brunette 90s supermodel blowout hair and a confident glamorous gaze, wearing a black strapless tube top with secure coverage and layered gold necklaces including a prominent cross pendant with small hoop earrings. Stand her on a beach at sunset with shimmering ocean water, a softly blurred horizon, intense golden-hour backlighting, halo effect, sun flares, soft diffusion, sparkling water highlights, cinematic vintage-glam lighting, and dreamy atmosphere. Use an 85mm lens at f/1.8 with sharp natural facial detail and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent top, exposed underwear, nudity, sexualized pose, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: source sunset supermodel reference
assets.usage: Use only for hair, tube-top styling, sunset beach composition, gold jewelry, and backlight; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the brunette blowout, black tube top, gold cross necklace, waist-up 9:16 framing, ocean, and golden backlight. Keep the subject original adult and top secure; background may vary.

changes: Clarified an original adult subject and secure top coverage.
Replaced sexualized wording with confident glamour while preserving the 90s fashion intent.
